reviews.review:
TWO THUMBS UP!
Hands down one of the top 3 indie horror games I played in 2025. Possibly #1 (once I get that true ending).
CoRoT has a lot to deliver, but divulging anymore into what makes it fantastic would be a spoiler. Here's what you need to know:

- Heavily P.T. inspired AT FIRST. I thought this was just going to be another "P.T. Clone" but was VERY PLEASED to see the dev take their own creative liberties with their inspiration. There's a shift that occurs that made me realize this is so much more than what I initially thought it was going to be.
- As someone who has played HUNDREDS of indie horror games, CoRoT did a few things that I have never seen before with it's techniques that just absolutely blew me away.
- No Jumpscares. Pure atmosphere. Tension and terror carried through with a deep story that will have your head spinning. Audio and lighting are top notch and I praise the developer for having me completely unsettled from beginning to end. No cheap tricks. Just passion that is clearly visible through this dev's work.
- Okay, maybe one jumpscare.
- In a way, this game is an experience that's like Blue Prince meets P.T.. I won't say more, but if you know you know.
- Streaming this game was a blast. My viewers were just as invested and hooked as I was.

For $6, this isn't just a game, it's a full on experience that I DEVOURED. I thought I had gotten the "real ending" twice, just to learn there's more... if I can just figure it out. 
If you're a lover of horror this is a must.
